_comment: BEST-EFFORT KeeperHub workflow definition — NOT yet validated. Once a kh_ API key exists, run it through the hosted MCP validate_workflow tool (https://app.keeperhub.com/mcp) or regenerate the exact node configs with ai_generate_workflow, then POST /api/workflows/create. Node config key names inside data.config are educated guesses from the docs (nodes[{id,type,data:{label,config}}] + edges with sourceHandle 'true'/'false' on condition edges; Block trigger takes network+blockInterval; templating is {{@nodeId:Label.field}}). Placeholders in <angle brackets> must be filled from .env before creating: <LENS_ADDRESS_SEPOLIA>, <AAVE_POOL_SEPOLIA>, <GUARDED_ACCOUNT>, <AGENT_PUBLIC_URL> (public URL of the agent, e.g. an ngrok/cloudflared tunnel to WEBHOOK_PORT), <WEBHOOK_SECRET>. The threshold 1300000000000000000 is HF_WARN_THRESHOLD 1.3 at 1e18 — keep in sync with .env.
name: LIFELINE HF monitor (sepolia)
description: Every 25 blocks, read HealthFactorLens.healthFactorOf(pool, account); if HF < 1.3e18, POST an alert to the LIFELINE agent webhook, which plans and executes the rescue via check-and-execute.
